reviewer.name: Claude Opus 5.5
reviewer.method: Looked at rendered page images. Atlas labels and distinctiveness scores only helped to find pages; they did not set any score.

status.note: Derived from AI-selected pages. All archetypes are opt-in and none affects default output.

design_principles: Give one thing the whole page: a very large numeral or sentence does more than several medium ones (AR03:8, EN01:15).
Encode the current period by tone and size, so no legend is needed (EN01:18, EN01:21).
State numbers once in bilingual work, with each language reading in from its own edge (BI01:4).
Hang text from a firm vertical division instead of centring it (AR02:25, AR01:5).
Leave emptiness on purpose, above the block rather than below it (AR02:25, AR03:30); unused space at the foot reads as a run-out (EN01:136, EN02:26).
Use one heavy rule or one tint to group; hairlines and space do the rest (AR03:8, EN01:21).
Mirror the whole page for Arabic, not only its text alignment (BI05:2 and BI05:6).
Repeat a system so a long report stays legible, but keep the repetition quiet (AR02:25 across 17 sections).

archetypes.name: Asymmetric section opener
archetypes.page_role: Opens a chapter or major section on its own page.

required: title of up to about 90 characters
optional: standfirst of up to about 240 characters
list of chapter names for the position rail

layout.structure: One vertical strip on the reading-start edge. The remaining field holds a text block hung from the strip.

typography.number: about 3.5 to 4.5 times body, accent colour
typography.title: about 2.5 to 3.5 times body, bold, tight leading

archetypes.relationships: Text hangs against the strip and never overlaps it. The strip is either an image or a rail that shows this chapter's position among the chapters.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: The upper third stays empty, and this quiet is the main feature. There is no running header or footer.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: The strip and text swap edges as a whole page mirror. Bilingual titles stack, each aligned to its own edge of the field.

constraints: Title must not exceed 4 lines at display size
Text block must end above the bottom margin
steps: Drop key points beyond the limit into the following content
Fall back to a normal H1 with its standfirst

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No photograph, dissolving squares, colour system or goal tiles are reproduced. The position rail is original to this project.

not_implemented: image in the strip: only the chapter rail is built

archetypes.name: Performance page
archetypes.page_role: Single-page statement of results for a period.

required: at least 2 further metrics or trend groups
optional: up to 4 trend groups of 2 to 5 periods

layout.structure: Horizontal strata: title band, hero band, tile band, trend band, highlights band.

proportions.highlights: up to 0.22 of the text height

typography.hero: as large as the band allows, scaled to the figure's length
typography.trend_values: body size, bold for the current period

archetypes.relationships: The current period is dark and prior periods are tinted, so no legend is needed. Bars are drawn from values, never as decoration.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: Strata are separated by space, not boxes. Tiles are grouped with one heavy rule.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: Reading order, bars and alignment mirror. Digits stay left to right. Bar baselines start at the reading edge.

constraints: All strata must fit on one page
Negative values require a shared zero axis
steps: Move highlights to the following flow
Fall back to heading, metric row and table

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No portrait, mask, rounded panel, card arrangement or brand colour is reused; the two-column composition of the reference is replaced with horizontal strata.

not_implemented: images or charts inside a stratum

archetypes.name: Parallel ledger
archetypes.page_role: Comparative figures, in one or two languages, stated once.

required: at least one section with a title
rows with a label and one or more values
optional: index of the emphasised period column

layout.structure: Section bars, then rows. Label columns are at the outer edges, with number columns between them.

proportions.emphasis_column: about 1.25 times a normal number column

typography.emphasis_value: about 1.3 times body, bold, on a tint

archetypes.relationships: Each row belongs to both languages. Numbers appear once. The emphasised period column carries a tint from header to last row.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: Hairlines only and even row height. Space, not fill, separates sections.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: English at the left edge and Arabic at the right edge in bilingual form. Monolingual Arabic mirrors the columns, with the label on the right.

constraints: A section bar must keep with at least two rows
Column header repeats on each page
steps: Reduce emphasis size for long values
Reduce the number of value columns on a landscape page
Fall back to a standard table per language

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No logo, footer, palette or pill shape is reused. Shared numeric columns and emphasis are general table practices.

not_implemented: a total computed from its rows: figures are stated, never derived

archetypes.name: Statement page
archetypes.page_role: Gives a leadership message or key finding a full page.

required: sentence of up to about 200 characters

layout.structure: One large sentence on a shared left edge, with the attribution under it.

typography.sentence: about 3 to 4 times body, regular with bold keywords

archetypes.relationships: Weight contrast inside the sentence replaces all decoration.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: Space under the sentence is deliberately open.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: Mirrored. Bold Arabic must be checked per typeface, since many have a weaker bold than Latin faces.

steps: Fall back to a pull quote

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No portrait, gradient or colour panel is reused.

archetypes.name: Editorial sink
archetypes.page_role: Short stories or themes in columns.

layout.structure: A heading at the top, then columns that hang from a deep sink.

typography.heading: about 2.5 to 3 times body, two tones

archetypes.relationships: Images are locked to the column they introduce. Captions point to their image.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: Uneven column starts create a cascade; column feet end near a common line.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: The cascade descends from the reading edge.

constraints: Stories must be of similar length
steps: Remove the stagger and align column tops

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No photographs, watermark or pointer shape is reused.

archetypes.name: Image and slab divider
archetypes.page_role: Divider or cover with one strong image.

layout.structure: An image field with a solid or near-solid panel beside or over it.

archetypes.relationships: Text stays on the panel, and the panel gives a guaranteed contrast.
archetypes.whitespace_rhythm: The panel is the resting area.

constraints: Image must not contain important detail under the panel
steps: Fall back to the asymmetric opener

archetypes.principle_not_copied: No images, swirls or QR arrangements are reused.

archetypes.name: Figure matrix
archetypes.page_role: Compares many categories at one glance.

layout.structure: A tinted figure header over equal cells.

archetypes.relationships: All cells share one scale. A heat table is the table form of the same idea.
archetypes.rtl_bilingual: Cell order mirrors. Numbers keep their direction.

constraints: All cells must share a scale
steps: Fall back to one grouped chart

archetypes.principle_not_copied: Small multiples and heat tables are general charting practice.
